purpose: Supersedes only the `final_architecture` and `pareto` claims in the Science-Owner-authored results/stage4_science_claim_ledger.json (left otherwise untouched) with new safe wording reflecting the Coordinator's actual final decision.

supersedes.original_exact_safe_wording: Final sensor architecture selection remains UNRESOLVED; a formal Pareto frontier is NOT_READY.

updated_claims.exact_safe_wording: A final Stage-4 wearable architecture has been selected: CORE_PLUS_CONTEXT. Selection is evidence-driven and burden-aware (Gate D CONDITIONALLY_READY, coordinator-accepted bounded engineering uncertainty). EOG inclusion is conditional on pending external replication (HMC full-cohort); sparse EEG channel choice is conditional on pending full-cohort evidence (ds003838).
updated_claims.scope_limitation: Both HIGH-sensitivity conditional freezes (EOG/HMC, sparse-EEG/ds003838) remain subject to explicit revision triggers - this is a conditional, disclosed final decision, not an unconditional one.
updated_claims.prohibited_stronger_wording: 'Four sensors are proven sufficient'; 'EOG is externally validated'; 'sparse EEG is population validated'; 'the architecture is immutable/unconditionally final'; any claim omitting the conditional-freeze/revision-trigger scope above.
updated_claims.stage4_consumer_guidance: Cite results/final_wearable_architecture.json and docs/STAGE4_FINAL_ARCHITECTURE_CLOSURE.md for this claim; never the pre-closure PENDING wording in results/stage4_science_claim_ledger.json alone.

supersedes.original_exact_safe_wording: A formal Pareto (scientific-value vs. burden) frontier has not been computed - NOT_READY.

updated_claims.exact_safe_wording: A formal multi-objective Pareto dominance analysis has been completed (no single collapsed score). Pareto-relevant set: MINIMAL_CORE, CORE_PLUS_CONTEXT. Coordinator selected CORE_PLUS_CONTEXT from within that set on evidence-driven, burden-aware judgment, not because it mathematically dominates every alternative.
updated_claims.scope_limitation: MINIMAL_CORE remains Pareto-relevant (non-dominated) alongside CORE_PLUS_CONTEXT - this is not a unique mathematical winner. EVIDENCE_EXTENDED/EXPERIMENTAL_EXTENDED remain POTENTIALLY_DOMINATED, not formally DOMINATED.
updated_claims.prohibited_stronger_wording: 'CORE_PLUS_CONTEXT mathematically dominates every architecture'; 'Pareto winner'; presenting any ranked sensor list as establishing a unique optimum.
updated_claims.stage4_consumer_guidance: Cite results/stage4_formal_pareto_analysis.json; never present potential_dominance as confirmed mathematical dominance.
